translations.web: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
translations.bsb: And though one may be overpowered, two can resist. Moreover, a cord of three strands is not quickly broken.
translations.kjv: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
translations.asv: And if a man prevail against him that is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
